items.desc: A flaw was found in pam. When built with libeconf and an unconfigured vendor directory, the pam_econf configuration handler misinterprets the search path, causing it to look for configuration files in a relative directory within the current working directory. A local attacker can exploit this by placing crafted environment configuration files in a world-writable location. If an administrator executes a privileged command from that directory, the malicious variables are loaded into the privileged process, resulting in local privilege escalation.
